title: What a Vision Transformer and a Language Model Treat Alike
subtitle: Neural Coherent Sets of images through DINOv2 ViT-S/14, and of token contexts through Mamba-130m
short_title: Neural Coherent Sets: ViT and Mamba
description: The label-free construction of the ResNet-20 report, run on a self-supervised vision transformer and on a state-space language model, with an explorer for each and the findings argued from it.
